recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1970s pop music album cover featuring a centered male portrait framed by a thin rounded-corner border, set against a naturalistic background of textured tree trunks, topped with bold, extruded display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a rounded-corner frame
Warm skin tones contrasting with cool grey-blue clothing
Bold headline typography anchored to the top margin
Organic tree textures framing the human subject
coreInvariants: Natural outdoor lighting with soft shadows
Muted, desaturated color palette for clothing and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point, reinforced by the framing of the tree trunks.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top headline, move down the vertical tree lines to the subject's face, and settle on the textured fringe of the shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cream-colored border area outside the rounded frame provides breathing room for the title and metadata.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white for the outer border and background highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and greys from the tree bark and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Orange and purple used exclusively for the extruded text effect.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photographic elements allows the high-saturation, high-contrast typography to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors
Limit clothing to muted pastels or neutrals

letterConstructionRules: Heavy 45-degree downward extrusion to the right

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space above the photo frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face paired with small, functional sans-serif metadata.
graphicDevices: Small square logo placeholder in top left corner

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Pump Triline or similar heavy rounded sans
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thick, friendly geometry of 70s pop aesthetics
Provides the necessary weight and clarity for the period style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up of a smiling man with 1970s feathered hair wearing a grey fringe western shirt, standing between two large textured tree trunks. The image should be enclosed in a thin black rounded-corner frame with a wide cream-colored outer border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, all-caps, extra-bold rounded sans-serif text at the top. Apply a deep orange 3D extrusion effect pointing down and to the right. Add a small square icon in the top left and small red metadata text in the top right.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a thick 3D extrusion?
Is the man's hair and clothing period-accurate to the early 70s?
Is the color palette muted except for the headline?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the inner photo frame.
Ensure the extrusion color is distinct from the letter face color.
Verify the fringe on the shirt is clearly visible and textured.
Confirm the rounded corners of the frame are symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered 70s-style portrait, wrap it in a rounded-corner frame with wide cream margins, and crown it with heavy, extruded, all-caps display type.
